text:
Claire: Presales for MedLedger. They require tenant-level residency in ca-central1 or eu-west-1 only, no US egress. Also asking about BYOK with HSM and estimated pricing. Need short summary for legal + finance.

Jon: We can support strict tenant pinning on Dedicated; Hosted is preference-only. For Dedicated set fallback_policy="deny_on_capacity" so requests fail rather than cross-border. KV caches and embedding stores remain region-local by default.

Asha: Security: we support AWS KMS and GCP CloudHSM for BYOK. HSM-backed keys need an onboarding window (~7 business days) and extra attestation. We can provide SOC2 Type II and ISO27001 links. I'll request signed subproc attestations from our peering partner in CA  ETA 48h.

Marco: Pricing sketch: Dedicated multi-region reserve +20-35% depending on commit term. BYOK integration $5k one-time; HSM add-on $6k one-time + $1.5k/mo ops. Final numbers from finance.

Claire: Legal also asked for data deletion proof on termination. Asha, can you confirm we provide key destruction logs and a deletion attestation?

Asha: Yes for Dedicated we can coordinate key destruction and issue a signed attestation with audit logs. For Hosted we can mark keys deleted and provide deletion logs but limited by provider controls.

Jon: I'll add a short tech appendix for the POC runbook describing routing, fallback behaviors, and how we bind tenants to compute pools.

DeployBot: Created PRESALES-4922 assigned to Claire.

Claire: Thanks. Plan: draft two options (Hosted preference vs Dedicated strict-pin) and send to customer by Wed COB. If subproc attestation delayed, escalate to legal.
